d: In this interaction, Congress leader Sonia Gandhi speaks about the immense personal and family challenges she faced while raising her children, Rahul and Priyanka, under extraordinary circumstances. She recounts how her children were withdrawn from boarding school due to grave security threats just months before former Prime Minister Indira Gandhi's assassination. Following Rajiv Gandhi's assumption of office as Prime Minister, severe security protocols confined the children to their residence without normal social interactions or regular schooling.
